title: 第21章 砸坑小能手限时返场第22章 守株待僵
content_zh:
踢飞皇族僵尸，闪亮登场的小金人，正是一直在旁观看千鹤道长几人操作僵尸，然后被接连甩飞的观众——林道然。
忙着将几人从倒栽葱状态扶正的林道然忙完后，发现那些兵勇和护卫都死光了，而僵尸也即将跳进帐篷里。
林道然急忙念咒给自己加了一层金光咒，然后冲进帐篷。
正看见僵尸朝着小王爷插了过去，连忙一脚将僵尸踢飞出去。
【你干嘛啊！就差一秒，我就能和他玩种草莓游戏了！】
被踢飞的僵尸，弹身而起朝着林道然发出了吼声！
浑身金光的林道然看这僵尸还敢对自己吼，呵呵一笑。扭着脖子，掐着闪烁着雷电的拳头，发出嘎吱嘎吱的声音，不紧不慢地朝着僵尸走了过去。
“道爷一不注意，你就在道爷眼前杀了这么多人，现在还敢吼我？孽畜，你早已有取死之道了！”
皇族僵尸看着往自己这边走的小金人，怒吼一声，向着他一跳，跃过了五六米，来到林道然身旁，僵直的双臂朝着林道然狠狠地插去。
看到往自己插来的禄山之爪，林道然不退反进，举起闪烁着雷电的右拳，如同雷霆万钧，带着雄浑的力量，仿佛能开山裂石般在空中划过，带起阵阵风声，直击僵尸那僵硬的双爪。
砰——
拳头和尸爪对碰之间，发出沉闷的声响，扬起阵阵的尘土，将两者包裹住。
僵持了几秒后，两者同时倒飞而出。
“咳咳咳！”
撞倒了几棵树的林道然，咳嗽着从尘土飞扬的草丛中走了出来！然后脸色凝重地看向已经站直立正的皇族僵尸。
经过刚才的交锋，林道然发现皇族僵尸身上的银白色愈加多了。看来被雷劈过的皇族僵尸不能再用闪电奔雷拳对付了，不然怕是很快就要进化成银甲尸了！
“没想到跟你对攻也能增长练体经验！来，我们继续！看看是你先突破银甲尸，还是我先突破银体境！”
想着想着，林道然脸带兴奋地散去了手上的雷霆，只带着满身的金光冲了过去。
轰！
【炼体经验+80！】

轰！
【炼体经验+80！】
……
每次对攻都能获得80点的炼体经验，听着耳边不断响起的系统提示声，沉迷于对攻的林道然愈加兴奋了，手上的力气也慢慢加重！
……
【炼体经验+80！】
五六分钟后，随着最后的一声提示声响起，林道然用力将皇族僵尸轰开。
林道然只感觉到体内涌起了一股前所未有的力量，这股力量如同汹涌的潮水般在身体里奔腾涌动，让他身体里的每一寸肌肤，每一寸血肉，每一粒细胞都仿佛在被点燃着，灼烧着。
他的身体开始微微颤抖，周围的气场也随之发生变化。银白色光芒在他身上若隐若现，仿佛有一层神秘的光辉笼罩。
随着力量的不断汇聚，他感觉自己的身体仿佛在经历一场蜕变。肌肉更加紧实，骨骼更加坚硬，每一个动作都充满了爆炸性的力量。
“终于突破到银体境了！老登，接下来我们可以更开心地玩耍了！”
成功突破到银体境的林道然露出了标志性的憨厚笑容，然后捏紧拳头朝着皇族僵尸走去！
还没察觉到林道然变化的皇族僵尸，依旧吼了一声，然后朝着林道然攻击过去。
依旧是一拳对轰一爪！
然后这一次，闪耀着金光的拳头把幽蓝色的僵尸指甲砸断了，然后去势不减地将皇族僵尸的手臂也砸断了！
啊吼！！！
皇族僵尸发出一声凄厉的吼叫，然后向后跳了几步，用惊疑不定的目光打量着林道然。
【你这家伙嗑药了？还是扮猪吃老虎？
怎么突然变得这么强了？
content_en:
The golden man who kicked away the royal zombies and made his debut was exactly the audience who had been watching Taoist Master Qianhe and others operating the zombies, and then being kicked away one after another - Lin Daoran.
After Lin Daoran, who was busy lifting several people up from their fallen state, found that all the soldiers and guards were dead, and the zombies were about to jump into the tent.
Lin Daoran hurriedly chanted a spell to add a layer of golden light to himself, and then rushed into the tent.
Just when he saw the zombie thrust towards the young prince, he quickly kicked the zombie away.
【What are you doing! In just one second, I can play strawberry planting game with him! 】
The kicked zombie jumped up and roared towards Lin Daoran!
Lin Daoran, who was covered in golden light, laughed when he saw that the zombie dared to yell at him. He twisted his neck, pinched his fists that flashed with lightning, made a crunching sound, and walked towards the zombies unhurriedly.
"You killed so many people in front of Master Dao when he wasn't paying attention. Now you dare to yell at me? You evil beast, you already have a way to die!"
The royal zombie looked at the little golden man walking towards him, roared angrily, jumped towards him, jumped five or six meters, came to Lin Daoran's side, and stabbed Lin Daoran fiercely with his stiff arms.
Seeing the claws of Lushan thrust at him, Lin Daoran did not retreat but advanced instead. He raised his right fist that flashed with thunder and lightning. It was like a thunderous thunder. With powerful power, it seemed to be able to crack mountains and crack rocks. It streaked through the air, causing gusts of wind and hitting the stiff claws of the zombies.
Bang——
There was a dull sound as the fists and corpse claws collided, and bursts of dust were raised, wrapping the two.
After a stalemate for a few seconds, the two flew out at the same time.
"Cough cough cough!"
Lin Daoran, who knocked down several trees, walked out of the dusty grass coughing! Then he looked solemnly at the royal zombie who was already standing upright.
After the confrontation just now, Lin Daoran discovered that the royal zombies were getting more silvery white. It seems that the royal zombies that have been struck by lightning can no longer be dealt with with the Lightning Thunder Fist, otherwise they will evolve into silver-armored zombies soon!
"I didn't expect that fighting against you can also increase my physical training experience! Come on, let's continue! Let's see who breaks through the Silver Armored Corpse first, or I break through the Silver Body Realm first!"
Thinking about it, Lin Daoran dispersed the thunder in his hands with excitement on his face, and rushed over with only the golden light all over his body.
boom!
[Body training experience +80! 】
Boom!
[Body training experience +80! 】
…
Each time you fight, you can get 80 points of body training experience. Listening to the system prompts that keep ringing in your ears, Lin Daoran, who is addicted to fighting, becomes more and more excited, and the strength in his hands gradually increases!
…
[Body training experience +80! 】
Five or six minutes later, as the final prompt sounded, Lin Daoran blasted away the royal zombies with all his strength.
Lin Daoran only felt an unprecedented power surge in his body. This power surged through his body like a raging tide, making every inch of skin, every inch of flesh and blood, and every cell in his body seem to be ignited and burning.
His body began to tremble slightly, and the aura around him also changed. Silvery white light loomed over him, as if there was a layer of mysterious radiance shrouding him.
As his strength continued to gather, he felt as if his body was undergoing a transformation. The muscles are tighter, the bones are harder, and every movement is full of explosive power.
"I finally broke through to the Silver Body Realm! Lao Deng, we can have more fun next time!"
Lin Daoran, who successfully broke through to the silver body realm, showed his iconic honest smile, then clenched his fists and walked towards the royal zombies!
The royal zombie, who had not noticed Lin Daoran's change, still roared and then attacked Lin Daoran.
It’s still a punch versus a claw!
Then this time, the shining golden fist broke the blue zombie's nails, and then killed the royal family without losing force.The corpse’s arm was also broken!
Ah ho! ! !
The royal zombie let out a shrill roar, then jumped back a few steps and looked at Lin Daoran with doubtful eyes.
[Are you on drugs? Or pretend to be a pig and eat the tiger?
Why did he suddenly become so strong?
